(SMCI) material weakness history","url":"https://ctrlworx.com/material-weakness/smci/"},{"title":"Super Micro Computer (SMCI) FY 2026 10-K Analysis (Filed 2026)","url":"https://finvincio.com/super-micro-computer-smci-2026-10k-analysis/"},{"title":"Supermicro - 10-K annual report 2026","url":"https://companiesmarketcap.com/supermicro/sec-reports-10k/0001375365-26-000022/"}]

Super Micro's FY2026 10-K (fiscal year ended June 30, 2026) reports that internal control over financial reporting was still not effective, but the number of open weaknesses dropped from three to one.

- **Primary filing:** The SEC filing says the CEO and CFO judged disclosure controls ineffective at the reasonable assurance level, and management concluded ICFR was not effective. The conclusion rests on the material weakness previously identified in the FY2025 10-K filed August 28, 2025.
- **Remediation:** The company says it remediated three material weaknesses reported in its FY2025 annual report. It credits a redesign of the ERP security role structure and segregation-of-duties rulesets, plus the addition of qualified accounting leadership.
- **Remaining weakness:** It covers IT controls over certain financial reporting systems and monitoring of user access, with operating effectiveness testing planned for fiscal 2027.
- **Auditor:** For fiscal 2024, 2025 and 2026, the auditor issued an unqualified opinion on the financial statements and an adverse opinion on internal control over financial reporting. I didn't find the auditor's own report text, so this comes from a third-party analysis.

Sources conflict on one point. One tracker lists the FY2026 10-K as filed August 31, 2026, while the others don't give a filing date. I'd check the EDGAR filing directly before relying on that date.

The search turned up the fiscal 2026 10-K and several secondary write-ups, but no reporting of a restatement.

- **Filing:** The 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 is on EDGAR. A sec-api summary lists its filing date as August 31, 2026. The report is Super Micro's annual report under Section 13 or 15(d) for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. The same filing warns that the company was delinquent in certain SEC reporting obligations in prior fiscal years, which could raise the risk of SEC enforcement.
- **Financials:** Per sec-api, the company earned a 10.8% gross margin on net sales of USD 39.1bn in fiscal 2026, the lowest of the six fiscal years covered, while operating activities used USD 6,809.9m of cash.
- **Restatement:** Earlier, the company said there were no restatements of previously filed financial statements when it filed its delayed fiscal 2025 10-K. I found no report of a restatement in the fiscal 2026 material.
- **DOJ/SEC matters:** Document requests were first disclosed in early 2025. The company noted it had received subpoenas from the Department of Justice and the SEC seeking certain documents after allegations appeared in a short-seller report. In March 2026, a 19 March 2026 SDNY indictment was unsealed in which the company is not named as a defendant, per the company. The company also disclosed that it received an additional subpoena from the SEC Enforcement Staff on April 28, 2026, per its May 2026 10-Q.
- **Status:** The 10-K says the company is cooperating with a government investigation. One tracker reports no charge against the company found as of October 2026.

Caveat: the sources are uneven. The sec-api and EDGAR items are the most reliable. The recordlens and drillr pages are third-party trackers, and drillr's text contains unverified "selected" annotations, so I wouldn't rely on its figures. I didn't open the full 10-K, so check the EDGAR filing directly for the restatement and investigation language.

content.text:
**風險評分：約 70／100（偏高）**

這是我根據二手資料做的判斷，不是財報鑑識結論。我沒有開啟 10-K 全文逐項核對，下列數字多半來自第三方彙整，引用前請對照 EDGAR 原文。

## 推高風險的因素

1. **內控仍被判無效。** 管理層結論是 ICFR 與揭露控制皆無效，審計師對 ICFR 出具否定意見，財報本身則是無保留意見。這個組合已連續三年（FY2024–2026）。
2. **仍有一項重大缺失未解。** FY2025 的三項重大缺失中，兩項已宣告補強，剩下 IT 一般控制與使用者存取監控。這類缺失會影響所有依賴系統產生的數字，補強後的營運有效性要到 FY2027 才測試，所以 FY2026 的補強尚未獲證實。
3. **公司有前科。** 公司曾延遲申報 10-K，過去也有會計與治理爭議，10-K 自己也警告可能面臨 SEC 執法。
4. **外部調查仍在進行。**
   - DOJ 與 SEC 的傳票（subpoena）已經發出，SEC 在 2026 年 4 月 28 日又追加一份。
   - SDNY 在 2026 年 3 月 19 日公開一份起訴書，公司並非被告。
   - 追蹤網站稱截至 10 月尚無對公司的指控，但調查未結束，我不會把這當成已排除。
5. **基本面數字與舞弊風險訊號相符。**
   - FY2026 營收約 391 億美元，成長極快，截止點（cut-off）與認列時點風險高。
   - 毛利率約 10.8%，是六年最低。
   - 營業現金流約 −68 億美元，營收快速成長卻大量吃掉營運資金，應收帳款、存貨與供應商預付款項的估價與可回收性是重點。
6. **出口管制議題。** 對特定客戶與銷售管道的合規問題，可能牽動收入認列與或有負債的揭露。

## 壓低風險的因素

- 審計師對財報出具無保留意見，而且沒有找到 FY2026 重編（restatement）的報導。
- 管理層補強了 ERP 權限設計與職責分離，也增補了會計主管。
- 原本三項重大缺失降為一項，方向是改善。

## 需要自行核對的重點

- 審計報告的關鍵查核事項（CAM），看審計師把哪些科目列為高風險。
- 存貨跌價、應收帳款備抵、保固準備與供應商預付款的變動，是否和營收成長相稱。
- 附註的「或有事項」與「期後事項」，看調查有沒有新進展與損失估計。
- 營運現金流為負的完整原因，以及是否仰賴融資或保理（factoring）。

## 結論

重大誤述最可能出在收入認列時點、營運資本科目的估價，以及調查相關的負債揭露，這三項都在內控缺失與調查的影響範圍內。整體風險我評為 70 分。若原文顯示 CAM 集中在收入與存貨，或調查有實質進展，我會調到 75–80；若 FY2027 測試證明缺失已補強，我會下調。

Sources:
- [Super Micro Computer, Inc. – Form 10-K FY2026 (SEC)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001375365/000137536526000022/smci-20260630.htm)
- [Financial analysis of Super Micro Computer, fiscal 2026 (sec-api)](https://sec-api.io/insights/financial-analysis-of-super-micro-computer-fiscal-2026)
- [Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Reports Remediation Progress, With IT Control Weakness Remaining (Yahoo Finance)](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/super-micro-computer-smci-flags-091139487.html)
- [Super Micro's working capital is under pressure (Deep Quarry)](https://deepquarry.substack.com/p/super-micros-working-capital-is-under)

- [Inquiries concerning Super Micro Computer: case record and status (RecordLens)](https://recordlens.org/cases/doj-sec-inquiries-smci/)
